source.text: Καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ ἐλθεῖν αὐτὸν εἰς οἶκόν τινος τῶν ἀρχόντων τῶν Φαρισαίων σαββάτῳ φαγεῖν ἄρτον καὶ αὐτοὶ ἦσαν παρατηρούμενοι αὐτόν.

records.literal_gloss: And it came to pass in the going of him into [the] house of one of the rulers of the Pharisees on a Sabbath to eat bread, and they were watching him closely.

en.L: And it happened, when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} went into the house of one of the leaders of the Pharisees on a Sabbath to eat bread, that they were watching {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} closely.
en.B: One Sabbath {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} went to eat a meal at the house of one of the leading Pharisees, and the people there kept a close eye on {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: One Sabbath day Jesus went to eat a meal at the home of an important Pharisee. The people there were watching {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} carefully to see what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} would do.

es.L: Y sucedió que, al entrar {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} en [la] casa de uno de los jefes de los fariseos un sábado para comer pan, ellos {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} estaban observando atentamente.
es.B: Un sábado fue a comer a casa de uno de los fariseos principales, y los que estaban allí {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} vigilaban de cerca.
es.R: Un sábado, Jesús fue a comer a la casa de un fariseo importante. Los que estaban allí {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} observaban con cuidado para ver qué hacía.

fr.L: Et il arriva que, comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} était allé dans la maison d’un des chefs des Pharisiens, un jour de sabbat, pour manger du pain, eux {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}observaient de près.
fr.B: Un jour de sabbat, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} alla prendre un repas chez l’un des chefs des Pharisiens, et ceux qui étaient là {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}observaient de près.
fr.R: Un jour de sabbat, Jésus est allé manger chez un Pharisien important. Les gens qui étaient là {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} surveillaient de près pour voir ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} allait faire.

sw.L: Ikawa, alipoingia katika nyumba ya mmoja wa viongozi wa Mafarisayo siku ya Sabato kula mkate, nao walikuwa wakimchunguza kwa makini.
sw.B: Siku moja ya Sabato alikwenda kula chakula nyumbani kwa mmoja wa Mafarisayo wakuu, na watu waliokuwa pale walikuwa wakimtazama kwa makini.
sw.R: Siku moja ya Sabato Yesu alikwenda kula chakula nyumbani kwa Farisayo mmoja mashuhuri. Watu waliokuwa pale walimtazama kwa makini ili waone atafanya nini.

vi.L: Và xảy ra là khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vào nhà của một người trong các nhà lãnh đạo của người Pha-ri-si vào ngày Sa-bát để ăn bánh, thì họ đang theo dõi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} kỹ lưỡng.
vi.B: Vào một ngày Sa-bát, Đức Giê-xu đến dùng bữa tại nhà một nhà lãnh đạo trong giới Pha-ri-si, và những người ở đó cứ theo dõi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chằm chằm.
vi.R: Vào một ngày Sa-bát, Đức Giê-xu đến ăn một bữa tại nhà một người Pha-ri-si quan trọng. Những người ở đó theo dõi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} rất kỹ để xem {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ làm gì.

ko.L: 그분이 안식일에 바리새파 지도자들 가운데 한 사람의 집에 빵을 잡수시러 들어가셨을 때에 [이런] 일이 있었다. 사람들이 그분을 엿보고 있었다.
ko.B: 어느 안식일에 예수께서 바리새파 지도자 한 사람의 집에 식사하러 들어가셨다. 그곳 사람들은 예수를 유심히 지켜보고 있었다.
ko.R: 어느 안식일에 예수께서 바리새파 사람들의 중요한 지도자 한 사람의 집에 식사하러 가셨다. 그곳 사람들은 예수께서 무엇을 하시는지 보려고 예수를 유심히 지켜보았다.

pt.L: E aconteceu que, quando {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} entrou na casa de um dos chefes dos fariseus, num sábado, para comer pão, eles {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} estavam observando atentamente.
pt.B: Num sábado, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} foi comer na casa de um dos fariseus mais importantes, e as pessoas que estavam ali {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} vigiavam de perto.
pt.R: Num sábado, Jesus foi fazer uma refeição na casa de um fariseu importante. As pessoas que estavam ali {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} observavam com atenção, para ver o que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} ia fazer.

am.L: በሰንበትም እንጀራ ሊበላ ከፈሪሳውያን አለቆች ወደ አንዱ ቤት በገባ ጊዜ እንዲህ ሆነ፤ እነርሱም አጥብቀው ይመለከቱት ነበር።
am.B: በአንድ ሰንበት ከታወቁት የፈሪሳውያን መሪዎች ወደ አንዱ ቤት ምግብ ሊበላ ሄደ፤ በዚያ የነበሩትም በጥንቃቄ ይከታተሉት ነበር።
am.R: በአንድ ሰንበት ቀን ኢየሱስ ወደ አንድ ታዋቂ ፈሪሳዊ ቤት ምግብ ሊበላ ሄደ። በዚያ የነበሩት ሰዎች ምን እንደሚያደርግ ለማየት በጥንቃቄ ይመለከቱት ነበር።

decisions.choice: one of the rulers of the Pharisees: a Pharisee of standing, a leader among them
alternatives: an official who ruled the Pharisee movement
decisions.reason: The word means a ruler or leading man. The Pharisees had no single head; Luke means a man of rank among them, perhaps a member of the council, as Nicodemus was (John 3:1).

decisions.choice: to eat bread: to have a meal
decisions.reason: To eat bread is a common way of saying to eat a meal (14:15; Genesis 37:25). A Sabbath meal was cooked the day before, and guests were often invited after the synagogue gathering.

decisions.choice: watching closely: watching to catch him out
decisions.reason: The same verb is used of the scribes and Pharisees watching Jesus on another Sabbath to find a charge against him (6:7), and of spies watching him (20:20).

decisions.choice: eat a meal
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of the idiom; Literal keeps it.

decisions.choice: to see what he would do
decisions.reason: Readable says what the watching was for, as m3 explains.

decisions.choice: narration in the passé simple (L, B) and the passé composé (R); "il arriva que" kept at Literal for Luke's "it happened"
decisions.reason: As in Luke 5 and 7: the passé simple is the normal tense of written narrative and suits a public reading; Readable uses the passé composé, as French is spoken and read in school today. Jesus's words, the parable of 14:16-24 included, keep the tenses of speech at every level. This holds for the whole chapter.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun span on verb prefixes (alipoingia, wakimchunguza)
alternatives: a span as in the English
decisions.reason: As in Matthew, Swahili spans go only on free pronouns and possessives (mbele yake, kwangu, wangu), never on verb prefixes, which cannot take a capital; so Swahili has fewer spans than English through this chapter.

decisions.choice: "ăn bánh" (L); "dùng bữa" (B); "ăn một bữa" (R)
decisions.reason: "To eat bread" means to have a meal (meaning decision). Literal keeps the bread; "ăn cơm", the Vietnamese idiom, would bring rice into a Jewish meal, so Balanced and Readable say "a meal".

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in Korean, through Luke 14; the narrative honours Jesus with "께서" and -시-, Literal refers to him as "그분", Jesus speaks in 해라체 and people speak to him in 합쇼체
decisions.reason: Korean has no capital letters, so the setting has nothing to change (Korean style guide, sections 4 and 7).

decisions.choice: "빵을 잡수시러" (L); "식사하러" (B, R); "엿보다" (L), "유심히 지켜보다" (B, R)
decisions.reason: "To eat bread" means to have a meal (meaning decision), which Literal keeps word for word; the watching is watching to catch him out, which "엿보다" carries at Literal.

decisions.choice: comer (B); fazer uma refeição (R)
decisions.reason: As the English, Balanced and Readable give the sense of the idiom (m2); Literal keeps "comer pão". Portuguese "comer na casa de" already means to have a meal there.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic
alternatives: a capitalised form, as the English alternative
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting that capitalises pronouns for God and Christ has nothing to change in Amharic; pronouns for Jesus are written as for anyone else. This holds through the chapter.

decisions.choice: "እንጀራ ሊበላ" (to eat bread) at Literal; "ምግብ ሊበላ" (to eat a meal) at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: "እንጀራ" is the word for bread as daily food, and "እንጀራ መብላት" is itself an Amharic way of saying "to have a meal", so Literal keeps the Greek idiom without misleading; "ዳቦ" is kept for loaves.

source.text: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἄνθρωπός τις ἦν ὑδρωπικὸς ἔμπροσθεν αὐτοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: And behold, a man certain was with dropsy before him.

en.L: And look, there was a certain man in front of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} who had dropsy.
en.B: There in front of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} was a man whose body was swollen with dropsy.
en.R: A man was there in front of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. He had a sickness that made his body swell up with fluid.

es.L: Y mira, había delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} cierto hombre hidrópico.
es.B: Allí, delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, estaba un hombre que tenía el cuerpo hinchado por la hidropesía.
es.R: Delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} había un hombre. Tenía una enfermedad que le hinchaba el cuerpo de líquido.

fr.L: Et voici, un homme hydropique était devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.B: Devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} se trouvait un homme atteint d’hydropisie, le corps tout enflé.
fr.R: Il y avait là, devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, un homme malade. Sa maladie faisait gonfler son corps, parce que de l’eau s’y accumulait.

sw.L: Na tazama, mtu mmoja mwenye istiska alikuwa mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.B: Pale mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} palikuwa na mtu ambaye mwili wake ulikuwa umevimba kwa ugonjwa wa istiska.
sw.R: Mtu mmoja alikuwa pale mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. Alikuwa na ugonjwa uliofanya mwili wake uvimbe kwa maji.

vi.L: Và kìa, có một người kia mắc bệnh phù thũng ở trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Ngay trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} có một người mắc bệnh phù thũng, toàn thân sưng phù.
vi.R: Có một người ở đó, ngay trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Người ấy mắc một chứng bệnh làm cho thân thể bị sưng lên vì nước đọng lại bên trong.

ko.L: 그리고 보라, 그분 앞에 수종병에 걸린 어떤 사람이 있었다.
ko.B: 바로 예수 앞에 몸이 붓는 수종병을 앓는 사람이 하나 있었다.
ko.R: 그곳에 예수 앞에 어떤 사람이 있었다. 그 사람은 몸에 물이 차서 붓는 병을 앓고 있었다.

pt.L: E eis que havia diante {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}} um homem que sofria de hidropisia.
pt.B: Ali, bem na frente {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}, estava um homem com o corpo inchado pela hidropisia.
pt.R: Na frente {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}} havia um homem. Ele tinha uma doença que fazia o corpo dele inchar de líquido.

am.L: እነሆም፣ በፊቱ ሰውነቱ በውኃ ያበጠ አንድ ሰው ነበረ።
am.B: በዚያም በፊቱ ሰውነቱ በውኃ እብጠት የተያዘ አንድ ሰው ነበረ።
am.R: በዚያም በፊቱ አንድ ሰው ነበረ። ይህ ሰው በሰውነቱ ውስጥ ውኃ እየተጠራቀመ እንዲያብጥ የሚያደርግ ሕመም ነበረበት።

decisions.choice: with dropsy: suffering from a swelling of the body caused by fluid gathering in it
decisions.reason: The word is a medical term used only here in the New Testament. Dropsy (now called edema) is a sign of a serious illness, often of the heart, liver or kidneys.

decisions.choice: in front of him: in plain view; Luke does not say how the man came to be there
alternatives: a man placed there by the Pharisees to test Jesus
decisions.reason: The man is not said to be a guest, and he is sent away after he is healed (14:4). Some suggest he was put there to see what Jesus would do, since they were watching him (14:1); the text does not say so.

decisions.choice: look (L); not rendered as a separate word, or "now" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Luke uses this word to draw attention to what follows. "Behold" is old-fashioned; Literal says "look", and Balanced and Readable carry the force in the flow of the sentence.

decisions.choice: a sickness that made his body swell up with fluid
decisions.reason: "Dropsy" is an old word that many readers will not know. Readable describes the illness.

decisions.choice: "hydropique" (L); "atteint d’hydropisie, le corps tout enflé" (B)
decisions.reason: "Hydropique" is the exact French word, but few readers know it; Balanced adds what it means, and Readable describes the illness, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: mwenye istiska (L); umevimba kwa ugonjwa wa istiska (B); ugonjwa uliofanya mwili wake uvimbe kwa maji (R)
alternatives: ugonjwa wa kuvimba at every level
decisions.reason: "Istiska" is the Swahili name for dropsy, fluid gathering in the body (meaning decision m1). Balanced adds that the body was swollen, and Readable describes the sickness without the name, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "bệnh phù thũng" (L, B); described at R
decisions.reason: "phù thũng" is the Vietnamese name of the illness the meaning decision describes; Readable explains it, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "보라" (L) for idou, not rendered (B, R); "수종병" (L, B), "몸에 물이 차서 붓는 병" (R)
decisions.reason: As through Luke 13; the old name of the illness is explained at Balanced and replaced by a description at Readable, as the English does.

decisions.choice: eis que
decisions.reason: "Eis que" is the Portuguese word for this pointer to what follows and is still current in written narrative, unlike English "behold"; Literal keeps it, as Matthew does. Balanced carries it with "bem na frente dele".

decisions.choice: hidropisia (L, B); uma doença que fazia o corpo dele inchar de líquido (R)
decisions.reason: "Hidropisia" is the Portuguese name of the illness; Balanced adds that the body was swollen, and Readable describes it, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "ሰውነቱ በውኃ ያበጠ" (whose body was swollen with water) for dropsy
decisions.reason: Amharic has no common single word for dropsy; describing the swelling says what the meaning decision describes in words every reader knows.

source.text: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν πρὸς τοὺς νομικοὺς καὶ Φαρισαίους λέγων· Ἔξεστιν τῷ σαββάτῳ θεραπεῦσαι ἢ οὔ;

records.literal_gloss: And answering, Jesus spoke to the experts in the law and Pharisees, saying, Is it lawful on the Sabbath to heal or not?

en.L: And Jesus answered and spoke to the experts in the law and Pharisees, saying, "Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath, or not?"
en.B: Jesus responded by asking the experts in the law and the Pharisees, "Does the law allow healing on the Sabbath, or does it not?"
en.R: Jesus spoke to the experts in God's law and the Pharisees. He asked them, "Does God's law let a person heal someone on the Sabbath day, or not?"

es.L: Y respondiendo Jesús, habló a los expertos en la ley y fariseos, diciendo: «¿Es lícito sanar en sábado, o no?».
es.B: Jesús respondió preguntando a los expertos en la ley y a los fariseos: «¿Permite la ley sanar en sábado, o no lo permite?».
es.R: Jesús habló a los expertos en la ley de Dios y a los fariseos. Les preguntó: «¿Permite la ley de Dios sanar a alguien en sábado, o no?».

fr.L: Et, prenant la parole, Jésus parla aux experts de la Loi et aux Pharisiens, disant : « Est-il permis, le jour du sabbat, de guérir, ou non ? »
fr.B: Jésus prit la parole et demanda aux experts de la Loi et aux Pharisiens : « La Loi permet-elle de guérir le jour du sabbat, oui ou non ? »
fr.R: Jésus a parlé aux experts de la Loi et aux Pharisiens. Il leur a demandé : « Est-ce que la Loi de Dieu permet de guérir quelqu’un le jour du sabbat, ou non ? »

sw.L: Na Yesu akijibu, aliwaambia wataalamu wa sheria na Mafarisayo, akisema, "Je, ni halali kuponya siku ya Sabato, au la?"
sw.B: Yesu aliwajibu kwa kuwauliza wataalamu wa sheria na Mafarisayo, "Je, sheria inaruhusu kuponya siku ya Sabato, au hairuhusu?"
sw.R: Yesu aliwauliza wataalamu wa sheria ya Mungu na Mafarisayo, "Je, sheria ya Mungu inamruhusu mtu kumponya mgonjwa siku ya Sabato, au la?"

vi.L: Và Đức Giê-xu đáp lời, nói với các chuyên gia luật pháp và người Pha-ri-si rằng: "Có được phép chữa bệnh trong ngày Sa-bát hay không?"
vi.B: Đức Giê-xu lên tiếng hỏi các chuyên gia luật pháp và người Pha-ri-si: "Luật pháp có cho phép chữa bệnh trong ngày Sa-bát hay không?"
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu nói với các chuyên gia về luật pháp của Đức Chúa Trời và những người Pha-ri-si. Ngài hỏi họ: "Luật pháp của Đức Chúa Trời có cho phép chữa bệnh cho người ta trong ngày Sa-bát hay không?"

ko.L: 그러자 예수께서 대답하여 율법 전문가들과 바리새파 사람들에게 말씀하셨다. "안식일에 [병을] 고치는 것이 허락되어 있느냐, 아니냐?"
ko.B: 예수께서 율법 전문가들과 바리새파 사람들에게 물으셨다. "안식일에 병을 고치는 것을 율법이 허락하느냐, 허락하지 않느냐?"
ko.R: 예수께서 하나님의 율법을 잘 아는 사람들과 바리새파 사람들에게 물으셨다. "안식일에 아픈 사람을 고쳐 주는 것을 하나님의 율법이 허락하느냐, 허락하지 않느냐?"

pt.L: E Jesus, respondendo, falou aos especialistas na Lei e aos fariseus, dizendo: "É permitido curar no sábado, ou não?"
pt.B: Jesus reagiu perguntando aos estudiosos da Lei e aos fariseus: "A Lei permite curar no sábado, ou não permite?"
pt.R: Jesus falou com os especialistas na Lei de Deus e com os fariseus. Ele perguntou: "A Lei de Deus deixa uma pessoa curar alguém no sábado, ou não?"

am.L: ኢየሱስም መልሶ የሕግ አዋቂዎችንና ፈሪሳውያንን እንዲህ ሲል ተናገራቸው፦ «በሰንበት መፈወስ ተፈቅዷልን ወይስ አልተፈቀደም?»
am.B: ኢየሱስም የሕግ አዋቂዎችንና ፈሪሳውያንን እንዲህ ሲል ጠየቃቸው፦ «ሕጉ በሰንበት መፈወስን ይፈቅዳል ወይስ አይፈቅድም?»
am.R: ኢየሱስ የእግዚአብሔርን ሕግ ጠንቅቀው የሚያውቁትንና ፈሪሳውያንን አነጋገራቸው። እንዲህም ብሎ ጠየቃቸው፦ «የእግዚአብሔር ሕግ በሰንበት ቀን ሰውን መፈወስ ይፈቅዳል ወይስ አይፈቅድም?»

decisions.choice: answering: responding to the situation, though no one had spoken
alternatives: replying to a question someone had asked
decisions.reason: Luke often uses "answered" for a response to what is happening or to unspoken thoughts (5:22; 7:40). Here Jesus answers the silent watching of 14:1.

decisions.choice: experts in the law: scholars trained in the law of Moses
decisions.reason: Luke uses this word for the teachers of the law, the same group he elsewhere calls scribes (7:30; 11:45-52).

decisions.choice: is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath: whether healing counted as work forbidden on the Sabbath
alternatives: whether healing was allowed at all
decisions.reason: Jewish teachers agreed that saving a life overrode the Sabbath, but treating an illness that could wait was debated. Jesus has faced this question before (6:9; 13:14-16).

decisions.choice: experts in God's law
decisions.reason: As elsewhere in Luke, Readable says which law is meant.

decisions.choice: Does the law allow (B); Does God's law let (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say plainly that the question is what the law permits.

decisions.choice: los expertos en la ley (L, B); los expertos en la ley de Dios (R)
decisions.reason: Luke's word for men trained in the law of Moses (meaning decision m2). "Expertos en la ley" says what they were in plain modern Spanish; Readable adds "de Dios" as the English Readable does. The same through Luke.

decisions.choice: les experts de la Loi (every level)
decisions.reason: As at 7:30 and 10:25: men trained in the law of Moses, kept apart from the scribes ("les scribes", Readable "les spécialistes de la Loi"). Readable adds "de Dieu", as the English does.

decisions.choice: wataalamu wa sheria (L, B); wataalamu wa sheria ya Mungu (R)
decisions.reason: Luke's word for men trained in the law of Moses (meaning decision m2). "Wataalamu wa sheria" keeps them apart from the scribes (waandishi) and from modern lawyers (wanasheria); Readable adds "ya Mungu" as the English Readable does. The same through Luke.

decisions.choice: "các chuyên gia luật pháp" (L, B); "các chuyên gia về luật pháp của Đức Chúa Trời" (R)
decisions.reason: As in 10:25 for the same word; "luật sư" today means a lawyer in court, and "thầy thông giáo" is kept for the scribes.

decisions.choice: "율법 전문가들" (L, B); "하나님의 율법을 잘 아는 사람들" (R) for nomikoi
decisions.reason: As the Korean Luke 7:30 and 10:25.

decisions.choice: os especialistas na Lei (L); os estudiosos da Lei (B); os especialistas na Lei de Deus (R)
decisions.reason: As in 7:30 and 10:25.

decisions.choice: "የሕግ አዋቂዎች" (experts in the law) at Literal and Balanced; "የእግዚአብሔርን ሕግ ጠንቅቀው የሚያውቁ" (those who know God's law well) at Readable
alternatives: "የሕግ መምህራን" (teachers of the law), the word used for the scribes
decisions.reason: Luke's word here is different from the word for scribes, so Amharic keeps a different phrase; "አዋቂ" names a learned expert.

fr.L: Mais eux se turent.
fr.B: Mais ils ne dirent rien.
fr.R: Mais ils n’ont pas voulu répondre.

sw.L: Lakini wao walinyamaza.
sw.B: Lakini hawakusema neno.
sw.R: Lakini hawakutaka kujibu.

decisions.choice: were silent: they would not commit themselves to an answer

es.L: Y tomando [al hombre], lo sanó y [lo] despidió.

es.R: Entonces Jesús tomó al hombre y lo sanó. Luego le dijo que podía irse.

fr.L: Et, [le] prenant, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} le guérit et [le] laissa aller.

vi.B: Vậy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nắm lấy người bệnh, chữa lành cho người ấy rồi cho về.
vi.R: Vậy Đức Giê-xu nắm lấy người bệnh và chữa lành cho người ấy. Rồi Đức Giê-xu bảo người ấy có thể về.

ko.L: 그러자 그분이 [그를] 붙잡으시고 그를 고쳐 보내셨다.

pt.L: E, tomando-[o], {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} o curou e [o] despediu.
pt.B: Então {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} pegou o homem, curou-o e o mandou embora.
pt.R: Então Jesus pegou o homem e o curou. Depois disse a ele que podia ir.

am.L: ይዞትም ፈወሰው፤ አሰናበተውም።
am.B: ስለዚህ ሰውየውን ይዞ ፈወሰው፤ ከዚያም አሰናበተው።
am.R: ስለዚህ ኢየሱስ ሰውየውን ይዞ ፈወሰው። ከዚያም ኢየሱስ ወደ ቤቱ መሄድ እንደሚችል ነገረው።

decisions.choice: taking hold of him: Jesus touched the man as he healed him
decisions.reason: The verb means to take hold of someone. Jesus often heals with a touch (4:40; 5:13).

decisions.choice: let him go: sent him away, released him
decisions.reason: The verb is used for letting someone leave (8:38). The healed man goes home, and Jesus turns to the guests.

decisions.choice: the man
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the man so that he is not confused with Jesus.

source.text: καὶ πρὸς αὐτοὺς εἶπεν· Τίνος ὑμῶν υἱὸς ἢ βοῦς εἰς φρέαρ πεσεῖται, καὶ οὐκ εὐθέως ἀνασπάσει αὐτὸν ἐν ἡμέρᾳ τοῦ σαββάτου;

records.literal_gloss: And to them he said, Of which of you a son or an ox into a well will fall, and not immediately he will pull up him on [the] day of the Sabbath?

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to them, "Which of you, [if your] son or ox falls into a well, will not immediately pull him out on the Sabbath day?"
en.B: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to them, "If one of you had a son or an ox that fell into a well on the Sabbath, would you not pull him out right away?"
en.R: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to them, "Suppose your son or your ox fell into a well on the Sabbath day. You would pull him out at once, would you not?"

es.L: Y les dijo: «¿A quién de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} se le caerá un hijo o un buey en un pozo, y no lo sacará en seguida en [el] día del sábado?».
es.B: Luego les dijo: «Si a uno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} se le cayera un hijo o un buey en un pozo en sábado, ¿no lo sacaría enseguida?».
es.R: Luego les dijo: «Supongamos que a uno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} se le cae un hijo o un buey en un pozo un sábado. Lo sacaría enseguida, ¿no es cierto?».

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur dit : « Lequel d’entre vous, [si] son fils ou [son] bœuf tombe dans un puits, ne l’en retirera pas aussitôt, le jour du sabbat ? »
fr.B: Puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur dit : « Si l’un de vous voyait son fils ou son bœuf tomber dans un puits le jour du sabbat, ne l’en tirerait-il pas tout de suite ? »
fr.R: Puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur a dit : « Imaginez que votre fils ou votre bœuf tombe dans un puits le jour du sabbat. Vous allez le sortir de là tout de suite, n’est-ce pas ? »

sw.L: Naye akawaambia, "Ni nani kati yenu ambaye mwana wake au ng'ombe wake atatumbukia kisimani, naye hatamtoa mara moja siku ya Sabato?"
sw.B: Kisha akawaambia, "Kama mmoja wenu angekuwa na mwana au ng'ombe aliyetumbukia kisimani siku ya Sabato, je, asingemtoa mara moja?"
sw.R: Kisha akawaambia, "Tuseme mwana au ng'ombe wa mmoja wenu ametumbukia kisimani siku ya Sabato. Bila shaka angemtoa mara moja, sivyo?"

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với họ: "Ai trong các người có con trai hay con bò rơi xuống giếng mà lại không kéo lên ngay trong ngày Sa-bát?"
vi.B: Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với họ: "Nếu một người trong các người có đứa con trai hay con bò rơi xuống giếng trong ngày Sa-bát, chẳng lẽ người ấy không kéo lên ngay sao?"
vi.R: Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với họ: "Giả sử con trai hay con bò của các người rơi xuống giếng vào ngày Sa-bát. Các người sẽ kéo lên ngay, phải không?"

ko.L: 그리고 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "너희 가운데 누가 아들이나 소가 우물에 빠지면, 안식일에 곧 그를 끌어올리지 않겠느냐?"
ko.B: 그리고 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "너희 가운데 누가 자기 아들이나 소가 안식일에 우물에 빠졌는데 곧바로 끌어내지 않겠느냐?"
ko.R: 예수께서 또 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "너희 아들이나 소가 안식일에 우물에 빠졌다고 해 보자. 너희는 바로 끌어낼 것이다. 그렇지 않으냐?"

pt.L: E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes disse: "Qual de vocês, [se] o filho ou o boi cair num poço, não o tirará imediatamente no dia de sábado?"
pt.B: Depois {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes disse: "Se um de vocês tivesse um filho ou um boi que caísse num poço no sábado, não o tiraria de lá na mesma hora?"
pt.R: Depois {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} disse a eles: "Imaginem que o filho de vocês, ou o boi de vocês, caiu num poço no sábado. Vocês iriam tirá-lo de lá na mesma hora, não iriam?"

am.L: እነርሱንም እንዲህ አላቸው፦ «ከእናንተ መካከል ልጁ ወይም በሬው በሰንበት ቀን ወደ ውኃ ጉድጓድ ቢወድቅበት ወዲያውኑ ጎትቶ የማያወጣው ማን ነው?»
am.B: ከዚያም እንዲህ አላቸው፦ «ከእናንተ አንዱ ልጁ ወይም በሬው በሰንበት ቀን የውኃ ጉድጓድ ውስጥ ቢወድቅበት ወዲያውኑ ጎትቶ አያወጣውምን?»
am.R: ከዚያም እንዲህ አላቸው፦ «ልጃችሁ ወይም በሬያችሁ በሰንበት ቀን የውኃ ጉድጓድ ውስጥ ወደቀ እንበል። ወዲያውኑ ጎትታችሁ ታወጡታላችሁ፤ አይደለም እንዴ?»

decisions.choice: a son or an ox: the reading of the SBLGNT
decisions.reason: Many early manuscripts read "son" here, including some of the oldest papyri and the codex Vaticanus. Others, including the codex Sinaiticus, read "donkey", which matches the ox and donkey of 13:15, and one reads "sheep", as in Matthew 12:11. "Son" is the harder reading, and copyists would more likely change it to an animal than the reverse. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: well: a well or cistern dug deep into the ground
decisions.reason: Wells and cisterns were dug down into the rock to hold water. A child or an animal that fell in could drown and needed to be pulled out at once.

decisions.choice: the question expects the answer: every one of you would
alternatives: a real question about what the law allows
decisions.reason: No one would leave a son or even an ox to die because it was the Sabbath. If they would rescue their own on that day, how much more should this man be helped (13:15-16).

decisions.choice: If one of you had ... would you not (B); Suppose ... would you not? (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable set out the case first and then ask the question, which is easier to follow.

decisions.choice: {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}
decisions.reason: Jesus speaks to many, so every plural "you" takes the reader setting: "ustedes" (Latin America, the default) or "vosotros" (Spain). English has no such choice. The same through this chapter.

decisions.choice: Jesus speaks to the experts and Pharisees as "các người"
decisions.reason: As in 5:22 and 6:3: the style guide's form for Jesus speaking to opponents.

decisions.choice: "곧" (L), "곧바로" (B), "바로" (R) for eutheōs
decisions.reason: The project's Korean words for euthys at the three levels, used for this related word too.

source.text: καὶ οὐκ ἴσχυσαν ἀνταποκριθῆναι πρὸς ταῦτα.

records.literal_gloss: And not they were able to reply to these things.

en.L: And they were not able to reply to these things.
en.B: And they had no answer to give to this.
en.R: They could not say anything against what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said.

es.L: Y no pudieron replicar a estas cosas.

vi.R: Họ không thể nói gì để cãi lại lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그러자 그들은 이것들에 대하여 대꾸할 수 없었다.
ko.B: 그들은 이 말씀에 아무 대답도 하지 못했다.

pt.L: E não foram capazes de responder a estas coisas.

am.B: ለዚህም የሚሰጡት መልስ አልነበራቸውም።
am.R: በተናገረው ነገር ላይ ምንም ሊሉ አልቻሉም።

decisions.choice: reply: answer back, argue against
decisions.reason: The verb means to answer in return or to speak against (Romans 9:20). They could find nothing to say against him.

decisions.choice: say anything against what he said
decisions.reason: Readable makes the sense of the verb plain.

source.text: Ἔλεγεν δὲ πρὸς τοὺς κεκλημένους παραβολήν, ἐπέχων πῶς τὰς πρωτοκλισίας ἐξελέγοντο, λέγων πρὸς αὐτούς·

records.literal_gloss: He was speaking then to those having been invited a parable, noticing how the first places they were choosing, saying to them,

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} told a parable to those who had been invited, noticing how they were choosing the places of honor, saying to them,
en.B: When {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} saw how the guests were picking out the places of honor for themselves, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gave them a parable:
en.R: Jesus saw that the guests were choosing the most important places at the table for themselves. So {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gave them a lesson from everyday life:

decisions.choice: the first places: the places of honor at the table
alternatives: the first places to be served
decisions.reason: At a formal meal guests reclined on couches around low tables, and the places nearest the host were the most honored. Where a guest lay showed his rank (11:43; 20:46).

decisions.choice: parable: here a piece of advice drawn from daily life that points to a deeper lesson
decisions.reason: The word covers proverbs, comparisons and stories (4:23; 5:36). This one is advice about where to sit, and its point comes in 14:11.

decisions.choice: noticing: paying attention to
decisions.reason: The verb means to fix one's attention on something (Acts 3:5). Jesus had been watching the guests as they had been watching him (14:1).

decisions.choice: a lesson from everyday life
decisions.reason: This parable is not a story, so Readable describes what it is.

decisions.choice: what Jesus noticed comes first

decisions.reason: Here the parable is advice from daily life that points to a deeper lesson (meaning decision m2). Literal and Balanced keep "parábola", the word through Luke; Readable says what it is, as the English Readable does.
